errors.text: The proposed strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^2 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics regime of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1, so its rate-sensitivity mechanism and boundary are evaluated in the wrong kinetic regime.

It predicts TWIP and FCC-to-HCP martensitic transformation as primary cryogenic yielding modes, whereas the target reports Shockley-partial slip and stacking faults, with no twinning or bulk phase transformation.
It misses the specific onset mechanism: dislocation nucleation at vacancy clusters or locally disordered atoms followed by a sudden stress drop.

The mechanism relies on evidence from compositionally different nanowires with free-surface effects and extrapolates Lomer-Cottrell unlocking, twinning, and martensitic transformation to a periodic bulk single crystal without direct support.
